title: An Investigation into Value Misalignment in LLM-Generated Texts for Cultural Heritage

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to a curated dataset of cultural heritage queries (CHVM-1K) using a dual approach of an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o) and manual assessment by heritage professionals to identify cultural misunderstanding, cultural reductionism, and contextual irrelevance.

Analyzing generated texts to detect skewed historical narratives, selective narration favoring dominant perspectives, and premature certainty on controversial topics, using prompt-based LLM evaluation verified by domain experts.
